newsitem.title: USA: Midwest Express August load factor down.
newsitem.headline: Midwest Express August load factor down.

text.p: Midwest Express Holdings Inc said the August load factor for its Midwest Express Airlines unit fell to 65.9 percent from 67.4 percent in same period a year ago.
The airline had 175.7 million available seat miles, up from 152.6 million in August 1995, and 115.8 million revenue passenger miles, compared with 102.8 million.

The August load factor at its Skyway Airlines unit rose to 46.1 percent from 44.2 percent. Available seat miles fell to 14.4 million from 15.2 million, while revenue passenger miles dropped to 6.6 million from 6.7 million.

For the year through August, Midwest Express had a load factor of 65.1 percent, up from 65 percent. There were 1.28 billion available seat miles and 830.7 million revenue passenger miles, compared with 1.22 billion and 792.7 million, respectively.
Skyway's load factor was 45 percent in the year to date, compared with 42.9 percent in the same period a year ago.
Available seat miles were 106.8 million and revenue passenger miles were 48.1 million, compared with 103.7 million, and 44.4 million, respectively.
